text:
Ava (marketing): quick sync  we need hero + subhead for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, a webinar CTA, and inbound routing. Drafts by Tue.
Jon (content): tone: engineer-first, compact. Drafts incoming. Example: Hosted hero: 'Start with Hosted API' sub: 'Minutes to integrate, pay-as-you-go.'
Maya (product): include 2 measurable claims under each hero (p50/p95, throughput, certs). Ops will supply numbers.
Ravi (growth): routing: form -> HubSpot. If company_size >=200 OR enterprise checkbox => AE queue, else SDR. Tag campaign=tri_mode_bench and add utm params.
Lena (demand gen): webinar promo: title 'Benchmarks: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private' line: 'Live walkthrough of latency, cost, and migration tips.' CTA variants: 'Reserve seat' / 'Get benchmark PDF'. Put CTA above the fold.
Jon (content): will prepare 2 hero variants per mode for A/B and push to staging. Use query flag hero_variant=A/B for QA.
Ava (marketing): editorial limits: hero <=10 words, subhead <=14 words. Keep it technical, avoid fluffy language. QA Fri AM.
